note: Public list prices read on the date, Linux x64, for the size each provider is tested at. Free minutes, plans and discounts are excluded from per-run cost. A flat monthly price ("flat-monthly") is a fixed monthly cost spread over the monthly job volume (METHOD.md, Cost), with the number of plans the volume needs.

skipbox-s.method: Plans needed at a monthly volume V of a workload's job = the concurrency V needs: ceil(V x mean job run time / (730 h x 3,600 s x U)), with U = 50% as for the always-on pool (gce-pool). Cost per job = $39 x plans / V. No per-minute price: the plan is billed per month whatever its use. The monthly price is used, not the yearly one.
